hero_sub: A practical AI roadmap for Joe and NextKey Growth Partners, built from the Blueprint AI form event, Bennett's existing white-label partner context, and the June 17 Read AI report. The immediate opportunity is not a generic sales reply; it is a clean partner-aware follow-up path with the correct recipient, approved link, and no premature referral-term commitment.
profile_note: Joe is not a cold form lead in isolation. Notion already identifies him as a podcast-host / white-label partner opportunity, with a Bennett approval gate before sending the Blueprint AI link or defining referral split. The Blueprint should therefore frame the opportunity as partner workflow design: confirm the right recipient, send the corrected link only after approval, and preserve every source and contact route.

results.title: Partner-led Blueprint AI growth depends on clean routing, not louder follow-up.
results.sub: When a podcast-host or referral partner sends audience interest into a funnel, the winning system is the one that keeps attribution, context, and next steps intact from the first form fill through fulfillment.

cards.title: They keep partner attribution attached to every lead
cards.desc: What they are doing: partner programs bind the source, host, audience segment, and offer path to every contact record. How it helps them: referrals do not get lost inside a generic CRM workflow. How I deliver it for Joe: a partner attribution agent that writes Joe, NextKey, source, and campaign context into the Blueprint AI workflow before any external send.

cards.title: They confirm the right recipient before delivery
cards.desc: What they are doing: teams route deliverables only after email identity is confirmed when multiple inboxes exist. How it helps them: the first partner touch feels precise instead of messy. How I deliver it for Joe: a recipient-confirmation agent that resolves support@nextkeygp.com, jgimage33@gmail.com, and joeglennon@yahoo.com before a Blueprint link is sent.

cards.title: They separate partner terms from operational follow-up
cards.desc: What they are doing: fulfillment teams send next-step links without accidentally committing to economics, pricing, or exclusivity. How it helps them: the relationship keeps moving while Bennett keeps control of commercial terms. How I deliver it for Joe: a partner-safe messaging agent that blocks referral split language until Bennett approves it.

cards.title: They turn podcast interest into reusable audience campaigns
cards.desc: What they are doing: partner teams use podcast context to build a reusable landing page, follow-up, and attribution flow for the host's audience. How it helps them: one conversation becomes a repeatable channel. How I deliver it for Joe: a Joe's AI Blueprint campaign path with tracked source capture and approved follow-up language.

results.close: The immediate win is disciplined execution: confirm identity, preserve source context, send the corrected link only after approval, and keep commercial terms gated.

agents.name: Partner Context Manifest Agent
agents.desc: Collects Joe's GHL contact ID, Read AI action items, Notion partner context, and lead notification into one execution packet.
agents.agent_prompt: You are the Partner Context Manifest Agent for Joe Glennon and NextKey Growth Partners. Before any Blueprint AI follow-up, gather the GHL contact ID, form source, submitted email, alternate emails, Read AI action items, Notion partner-row status, and Bennett approval gate. Produce one concise manifest with proof links, unresolved questions, and a clear send/no-send recommendation. Never invent public company facts and never approve external messaging yourself.
agents.outcome: No more disconnected partner follow-up. Every action starts from the same source-of-truth.

agents.name: Recipient Confirmation Agent
agents.desc: Resolves which Joe inbox should receive the next Blueprint or white-label link.
agents.agent_prompt: You are the Recipient Confirmation Agent for Joe Glennon. Compare every known email route: support@nextkeygp.com from the Blueprint AI form, jgimage33@gmail.com from the partner row, and joeglennon@yahoo.com from the transcript follow-up row. Draft a confirmation ask for Bennett that lists the options and blocks any customer-facing send until Bennett selects one. After approval, write the selected address back into the task receipt.
agents.outcome: The first external follow-up goes to the right person and the right inbox.

agents.name: White-Label Link Readiness Agent
agents.desc: Checks whether the promised white-label link exists and passes the required audit before anyone sends it.
agents.agent_prompt: You are the White-Label Link Readiness Agent for the Joe Glennon partner thread. Your job is to inspect the approved white-label link, confirm it returns HTTP 200, confirm it uses the correct partner source and attribution, confirm there are no Drive links or placeholder tokens, and confirm the destination captures identity through the tracked qualifier flow. If any check fails, label the link blocked and produce a fix list for Bennett instead of sending.
agents.outcome: Joe receives a working, tracked link only after it is actually ready.

agents.name: Partner-Safe Messaging Agent
agents.desc: Drafts partner-aware follow-up without accidentally committing to referral terms or pricing.
agents.agent_prompt: You are the Partner-Safe Messaging Agent for Franchise KI. Draft Joe Glennon follow-up messages that acknowledge the podcast chat and Blueprint AI request, ask for the correct recipient when needed, and move the next step forward. Do not mention referral split, pricing, exclusivity, partnership terms, or white-label promises unless Bennett has approved the exact wording in this run. Keep the message short, direct, and human.

agents.name: Podcast Audience Campaign Agent
agents.desc: Turns Joe's audience into a tracked application path once Bennett approves the white-label route.
agents.agent_prompt: You are the Podcast Audience Campaign Agent for a Joe Glennon Blueprint AI partner channel. Design a tracked audience path that starts from Joe's show or audience link, captures source and campaign metadata, routes users through the Blueprint AI qualifier/apply funnel, and preserves Joe attribution in GHL and Notion. Include UTM fields, webhook requirements, thank-you page routing, and a no-booking-before-qualifier rule.
agents.outcome: A repeatable campaign path for Joe's audience instead of one-off manual handling.

agents.name: Partner Pipeline Monitor
agents.desc: Keeps Bennett updated on partner leads, approvals, replies, and blocked actions.
agents.agent_prompt: You are the Partner Pipeline Monitor for Blueprint AI white-label partners. Every day, summarize Joe Glennon partner activity: new form fills, replies, approval status, link readiness, GHL contact changes, Notion row changes, and any blocked sends. Separate completed work, waiting-on-Bennett items, waiting-on-Joe items, and audit failures. Never mark delivered unless Gmail/telemetry and artifact proof both exist.
agents.outcome: Bennett sees the partner pipeline without manually checking every system.
